title: Halton Borough Council: Digital front door in family hub services
summary: Halton reports that its family-hub platform offers round-the-clock information and that automation has begun reducing administrative work.
account: Halton is embedding a Beebot AI digital front door for family-hub services, with chatbots, personalized information, and automated administrative processes. The source states that automated processes have begun to streamline workflows and reduce staff administrative burden. It gives no measured family outcome or uptake figure.
purpose: Provide families with accessible information, personalized signposting, and a digital route to family-hub services.
system: Beebot AI family-hub Digital Front Door

ratings.reason: The council reports that automation has begun streamlining workflows and reducing administrative work.
The implemented platform offers convenient 24/7 information, notifications, and live-chat access. Deeper improvements in family wellbeing are not reported.

ai_role.statement: The platform uses AI chatbots, personalized information, and automation. The council reports that administrative workflows have begun to improve, but it does not isolate AI from other platform functions or measure changes in family wellbeing.

evidence.citation: Council or project account published in the Local Government Association AI case-study bank. The account provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Halton Borough Council: Digital front door in family hub services

produced_by: The project uses government funding and integrates desktop and mobile access, notifications, chatbots, and staff live chat.
The service was still being embedded within the council at publication.
must_hold: The conditions needed to reproduce the benefit are unspecified.

headline: Halton introduces a family-hub digital front door
claim_basis: Sources: the deployer's report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
